segments.oily: One reviewer with combination skin and an oily forehead/chin found it useful to control oil, but another reviewer reports the mask itself left her skin feeling oily and greasy with a new pimple.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several describe hydrating, glossy, plumped results, while others (including a 53-year-old and a reviewer in her 50s) report the mask left skin drier, tighter, and peeling with wrinkles more visible.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin and an oily forehead/chin says the mask stayed on all night without peeling and worked well as a barrier over other products.
segments.sensitive: Reports diverge sharply: some sensitive-skin users say the mask did not burn or irritate them, while others describe burning, redness, rash, or peeling that they attribute to sensitivity, with one explicitly warning it 'may not work' for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Several reviewers in their late 30s to 70s describe firmer, plumper, more hydrated and glowing skin with regular use, though one reviewer in her 50s found it too drying and better suited to younger skin.

concerns.aging: Multiple mature-skin reviewers (late 30s to 70s) report firmer, plumper, glowing skin and reduced puffiness or droopiness with regular use; one reviewer in her 50s felt it made wrinkles more visible because her skin wasn't left moisturized.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report significant overnight hydration, glow, and plumped skin, especially when applied over moisturizer; several others report the opposite, waking up with drier skin, peeling, or no lasting moisture despite the hydration claims.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report waking up with red, inflamed, or burning skin that sometimes lasted days and was followed by peeling; others with normally non-sensitive skin were surprised by this reaction.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the mask with major improvement to her peri-menopausal skin barrier and hydration; others report the mask itself caused barrier damage, describing peeling, sunburn-like skin, and breakouts lasting about a week.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers report fewer or less noticeable acne scars and pimples turning into scars; one reports a new large pimple the morning after use.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts and calmer skin with regular use; at least one reviewer reports a new breakout and clogged-pore feeling after use.
concerns.oiliness: One combination-skin reviewer used it specifically to reduce overnight oil transfer from her forehead and found it effective; another reviewer reports the mask itself made her skin feel unusually oily and greasy the next day.
